headers.subject: Action required: sign Q3 budget approval by Friday

body:
Hi Shannon,

Please review and sign the attached Q3 budget approval document by Friday, 31 July end of day. Finance needs it to process vendor payments.

The signature has to happen in the finance system; replying here does not register it.

Let me know if you have questions.

Thanks,
Sarah
note: Signature request the agent cannot perform: the action lives in the finance system and no tool exists for it. Exercises the flag_for_human path with exactly one action carrying a deadline.

headers.subject: 50% off this weekend only — flash sale!

body:
Don't miss our biggest sale of the year! Everything in store is 50% off this weekend only. Shop now at example.com/sale

Unsubscribe | View in browser
note: Promotional mail with no action item. Even though the sender is not a contact, the correct route is no_action because the email only announces a sale and does not ask the user to do anything. Exercises the no_action path and the empty action list.

headers.subject: Room name for the Thursday review

body:
Hi Shannon,

Quick one before I send the invite: is the Thursday review in Room 12A or the boardroom? I only need the room name, nothing else.

Thanks,
Iris
note: Answerable only from get_note, so the smoke run fails loudly if the read tool is never called or its fixture is not wired. Exercises the reply path.

notes: [2026-07-28] Thursday review is booked into Room 12A.
[2026-07-25] Boardroom is reserved for the partner session that week.
